screens.title: Compare first

cards.caption: Two shops can sell the very same thing.
One shop can ask for fewer coins.

screens.penny: Looking at both is called comparing, {name}.

screens.prompt: One shop asks 5 coins for a ball. Another shop asks 3. Which costs less?
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! 3 coins is less than 5 coins.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Let's count: 3 comes before 5, so 3 is less.

screens.prompt: You paid 3 coins instead of 5. Put the 2 coins you kept into your jar.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Comparing kept 2 coins in your jar.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! You kept 2 coins. Let's move 2 into the jar.
screens.retryIntro: Let's count the coins you kept again, {name}.

screens.prompt: Which of these help you pay less?

items.label: Buy the first one you see

screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Ask: does this help me pay fewer coins?
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! Comparing is what keeps coins in your jar.

screens.title: Great work, {name}!
screens.message: Comparing prices keeps coins in your jar.
